1.title: VetiGo — Team Project
1.description: A full-stack veterinary platform that simplifies pet care through appointment booking, pet profile management, nearby veterinarian discovery, and AI-powered first-aid guidance for pet emergencies.

fullDescription.desc: VetiGo is a full-stack web application designed to make veterinary care more accessible. It enables pet owners to manage their pets' profiles, schedule veterinary appointments, discover nearby clinics, and access AI-assisted first-aid guidance when urgent situations arise.
fullDescription.frontend: Developed with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and DaisyUI. Integrated Axios for API communication, Formik for form management, and Google Maps MarkerClusterer for interactive veterinarian discovery. Deployed on Netlify.
fullDescription.backend: Developed with Node.js, Express, and MongoDB using Mongoose for data modeling. Integrated Firebase for file storage, OpenAI for AI-assisted support, Multer for file uploads, and JWT with bcryptjs for authentication and password security. Deployed on Render.

frontend: Authentication and Access Control: Secure user authentication with role-specific experiences for pet owners and veterinarians.
Pet Profile Management: Create, update, view, and delete pet profiles and their associated information.
Appointment Management: Schedule, update, and cancel veterinary appointments.
AI-Assisted Emergency Guidance: Access AI-generated first-aid information to help pet owners respond to potential emergencies.
Veterinarian Discovery: Explore nearby veterinary services through an interactive Google Maps integration with marker clustering.
Responsive User Interface: Access core platform functionality across desktop and mobile screen sizes.

backend: Authentication and Authorization: JWT-based authentication, password hashing with bcryptjs, session validation, and authorization middleware.
File Upload and Storage: Handle user-uploaded files using Multer and Firebase.
AI Integration: Connect the OpenAI Chat Completions API to provide AI-assisted emergency guidance.
REST API Development: Support frontend functionality through structured API endpoints and server-side request handling.
Database Management: Store and manage application data using MongoDB and Mongoose.

2.title: Nice Gadgets — Team Project
2.description: A responsive e-commerce application for browsing and purchasing consumer electronics, featuring product discovery, detailed product pages, sorting and filtering, favorites, and shopping cart functionality.

fullDescription.desc: Nice Gadgets is an e-commerce web application built to deliver a streamlined online shopping experience. Users can explore a product catalog, refine results using filtering and sorting controls, view detailed product information, save favorite items, and manage their shopping cart through an intuitive, responsive interface.
fullDescription.frontend: Developed with React, Redux, HTML, and SCSS, using Webpack for bundling. Implemented reusable interface components and centralized state management to support product browsing, favorites, and shopping cart interactions. Deployed on GitHub Pages.
fullDescription.backend: Developed with Node.js and TypeScript, deployed on Railway.

frontend: Product Catalog: Browse a structured collection of consumer electronics and access detailed product information.
Filtering and Sorting: Refine product listings to make product discovery more efficient.
Favorites Management: Save and revisit preferred products.
Shopping Cart: Add products to the cart and manage selected items.
State Management: Use Redux to coordinate application state across interactive shopping features.
Responsive Design: Provide a consistent browsing experience across different screen sizes.
backend: Developed a RESTful API for an online electronics store featuring phones and tablets.
Implemented endpoints to retrieve product collections and detailed product information by ID.
Added product sorting by price, newest arrivals, and alphabetical order.
Implemented pagination with configurable page numbers and page sizes.
Created endpoints to retrieve products with the biggest discounts.
Added endpoints to retrieve the total number of phones and tablets.
Designed consistent API routes to support dynamic product listings, product detail pages, and discounted product sections.

3.title: BOSE
3.description: A responsive landing page inspired by BOSE's premium digital brand experience, combining a clean visual hierarchy, carefully structured layouts, and responsive styling.

fullDescription.desc: This project recreates the visual experience of a BOSE-inspired product landing page, with an emphasis on modern layout techniques. The implementation focuses on translating a premium brand aesthetic into a accessible web interface.
fullDescription.frontend: Developed using semantic HTML, SCSS, and the BEM naming methodology to create a modular, organized, and maintainable stylesheet architecture. Deployed on GitHub Pages.

frontend: Responsive Layout: Adapt the page structure to different viewport sizes and devices.

4.title: Visual Monitor — Website Visual Regression Tool
4.description: Independently developed a tool for Lichtline GmbH’s website to detect visual changes and streamline regression testing when updating reusable website modules. Helped verify that module updates remained visually consistent across pages.

fullDescription.desc: Developed to streamline regression testing when updating reusable website modules. The tool helped verify module changes remained consistent across pages where the same components were used in different contexts, reducing manual testing effort and making it easier to identify issues.
fullDescription.automation: Developed with TypeScript, Playwright, and Node.js, using Chromium for browser automation. Integrated Pixelmatch for pixel-level image comparison and PNGJS for image processing. Stabilizes screenshots by removing cookie overlays, disabling animations, and masking video players.

automation: Multi-Page Monitoring: Automatically capture and compare full-page screenshots across 24 configured website pages.
Automatic Baseline Creation: Generate reference screenshots when a page does not yet have a saved baseline.
Visual Difference Detection: Compare screenshots using configurable color sensitivity and changed-pixel thresholds.
Highlighted Difference Images: Save updated screenshots alongside images highlighting detected pixel differences.
Screenshot Stabilization: Remove cookie and consent overlays and disable animations and transitions before capture.
Video Masking: Exclude video players, controls, and loading indicators from comparisons to reduce inconsistent results.
Dimension Change Detection: Identify screenshot size changes and save a separate visual indicator.
Non-Blocking Visual Checks: Record visual differences without failing the test or stopping subsequent page comparisons.
Timestamped Results: Preserve detected changes with page names and timestamps for later review.
Cleanup Command: Clear generated change images while preserving baseline screenshots.
